notes.title: Corona Blossom Vol.3 August 2019 Update.
notes.notes:
An updated version of the game is now online.

Fixed a playback issue of the ending movie in the Extra Menu.

notes.title: Corona Blossom Vol.3 Journey to the Stars Chinese language version
notes.notes:
In the next few days we are going to push an update which will add Chinese language localization for Corona Blossom Volume 2 and 3. 
We will post another announcement once the update is live. For more information in Chinese about our games etc. please visit our Weibo official account.
